issues.what: The first-star watch is set up ('No star, no supper') and then dropped; the star never appears.
issues.quote: Keep watching. No star, no supper.

issues.what: Taras is named by the narrator before he ever gives his name.
issues.quote: The man, Taras, left his backpack in the hall

issues.what: Confusing line about 'his better ear'; the deaf ear in the brief is Halina's.
issues.quote: to his better ear, though which one that was she did not know

issues.what: Kuba wishes for a better battery on a phone the brief says he does not have yet.
issues.quote: I wish my phone has good battery

issues.what: 'Gwiazdka' used as a greeting; stray leading space in dialogue; missing Polish accent and hyphens.
issues.quote: " Mama!" Basia said from behind.

fix: Small edits only: pay off the first star, let Taras give his name, fix the ear line and Kuba's wish, and clean the typos.
praise: The crowded kitchen and the 1964 apples story carry the feeling in small gestures, and it ends quietly on the candle, just as it should.

issues.what: Brief text pasted into the prose, repeating the landing just described.
issues.quote: At dawn Tyrell ran the boat onto black sand under the steaming dome, and jumped out

issues.what: Age math: 52 in the present day means she was about 21 in 1995, not sixteen.
issues.quote: She had been sixteen.

issues.what: Her father handed her a calypso tape at the jetty, which undercuts the premise that the only recordings are in the basement.
issues.quote: Her father had pressed a calypso tape into her hand

issues.what: Tyrell wears a sleeveless vest and no shirt; later his vest has 'sleeves' and the reels sit 'inside Tyrell's shirt'.
issues.quote: Tyrell tied his shirt over his nose

issues.what: Tyrell is barefoot, yet water pulls at 'their boots'; 'thin' wrist/fingers image repeated from ch1; 'Thirty years' repeated.
issues.quote: the water pulling at their boots

issues.what: The label is in 'different handwriting', but ch3 treats it as her father's.
issues.quote: The label was in different handwriting, hurried.

issues.what: Dropped thread: the 'For D, play for M' tape is never played. A master reel goes into a cassette slot instead, and Merle's line about spelling Sweeney makes no sense.
issues.quote: He never could spell Sweeney right on a label.

issues.what: Brief text pasted again; the engine is still ticking hours later and the dome glows dawn-pink at midday.
issues.quote: where Tyrell had run it on at dawn under the steaming dome, the engine ticking

issues.what: Geography drift: the school is 'two streets over' but is now at her feet by the station, and the blue roof moves to the church.
issues.quote: a triangle of blue roof she remembered from choir practice

issues.what: Generic title that names a minor detail; Rennard's decision about reporting them is never resolved.
issues.quote: Parris Shop

fix: Ch1: remove the pasted brief sentence, fix her age in 1995, the father gives a squeeze instead of a tape. Ch2: vest not shirt, bare feet, handwriting is his, cut repeated images. Ch3: retitle, fix the view back to the school, fix the boat and dome, play the small tape at the end, close Rennard's report thread.
praise: Rennard counting the earthquakes over the radio is a superb clock, and the ash, heat and sulphur feel physically real.

issues.what: Wrong fact for a kids story: yaks grunt, they do not moo (the species name means 'grunting ox').
issues.quote: Boorsok mooed. Mooo!

issues.what: Safety: an 8-year-old climbs a mountain alone and slips on stepping stones in a fast stream; no adult can see her.
issues.quote: She stepped. One. Wobble. Two. Slip.

issues.what: Contradiction: first he loves hats more than dough, later he loves dough more than hats (and that is the solution).
issues.quote: He loved hats even more.

issues.what: The yak is suddenly 'shivering', and she takes off her jacket in a cold mountain wind; neither is needed or safe to copy.
issues.quote: She put her own jacket around his shivering back

issues.what: The rope goes 'around his neck like a belt'; lake name is missing its umlaut (Song-Köl).
issues.quote: tied her rope soft around his neck like a belt

fix: Ch1: yak grunts (a true fact), shallow stream and Grandpa watching the whole hill, no slip, hats-vs-dough made consistent, cut the jacket line, gentler rope wording, Song-Köl.
praise: The whistle code is a lovely device: it guides her over the stream and pays off as 'come back for hot bread' at sunset.

issues.what: Real brands in the prose: a Manchester United jersey and a Bajaj bike.
issues.quote: a thin boy in a soaked Manchester United jersey

issues.what: Continuity: the jersey belonged to the conductor, but the recap gives it to Olalekan.
issues.quote: Olalekan miming an injection for the conductor in his soaked Manchester jersey

issues.what: The 'four o'clock' last ferry pulls away at half past three, so the title's deadline is lost.
issues.quote: By half past three, the Victoria Island jetty showed through the rain.

issues.what: Senami hands Adaobi the paddle and then says she will paddle herself; the umbrella was abandoned in ch1.
issues.quote: Him go hold umbrella wey no work.

issues.what: The cooler is on Olalekan's lap, then it bangs on Adaobi's spine with no handover.
issues.quote: Olalekan sat in front clutching the cooler on his lap now

issues.what: Geography: Lekki to Victoria Island does not cross Third Mainland Bridge. The title is generic because the ferry does not appear in ch1.
issues.quote: We must pass Lekki Expressway, then Third Mainland Bridge.

fix: Ch1: remove the brands, fix the route line, retitle. Ch2: ferry leaves at four, Senami hands over a bailer not the paddle, cooler returns to Adaobi, fix the jersey recap.
praise: The bus-roof crossing and Senami's haggling have exactly the loud, funny Lagos energy the brief asked for.

issues.what: Safety: an 8- and a 10-year-old hunt at night and chase the bird down to the harbour with no adult. Grandma is at home until the bakery.
issues.quote: Ylfa grabbed her box and ran after it.

issues.what: Wrong fact: a fledging puffling is black above and white below with a grey face, a small dark beak and dark feet. It is not all fluffy, and its feet are not orange.
issues.quote: Feet like orange jelly beans. It was not black and white yet

issues.what: Continuity: Bárður releases 'his own puffling' and holds a box, but he never caught one.
issues.quote: Then he let his own puffling go.

issues.what: Pufflings leave the burrow in late August, not all August.
issues.quote: Every August the baby puffins on Heimaey left their burrows.

issues.what: The 'fluffy' and 'orange feet' descriptions repeat in ch2.
issues.quote: Its orange feet stepped tap tap onto her hands.

fix: Ch1: Grandma is with them from the start and follows the chase, true puffling looks, late August. Ch2: Bárður brings a box with the puffling he found, and the looks fixes carry through.
praise: The rescue is taught through what the children do (sock practice, soft-cave hands, facing the wind), and the flying-potato release is a joy.
